statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, dizziness, and intermittent syncope
The symptoms are suggestive of underlying sick sinus syndrome and paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
CPT 93247 (long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring study) was ordered
The service is a 30-day continuous ambulatory ECG monitoring
The service was ordered to evaluate arrhythmia burden and guide further management
Diagnosis codes I49.5, I48.91, and I49.9 are associated with this patient
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197
The denial reason is that required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before the service was rendered
